# The bgs.protocol sources are machine-generated by protoc 2.6.1 (the .pb.cc /
# .pb.h files) plus the hand-written ServiceBase. They are compiled as-is and
# kept out of AzerothCore's strict warning build via acore-no-warning-interface.

CollectSourceFiles(
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  PRIVATE_SOURCES
  # Exclude
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PrecompiledHeaders)

if (USE_COREPCH)
  set(PRIVATE_PCH_HEADER PrecompiledHeaders/protoPCH.h)
endif()

# Group sources
GroupSources(${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})

add_library(proto
  ${PRIVATE_SOURCES})

# Collect include dirs so the generated headers resolve. Both the proto root
# (for "Login/Login.pb.h"-style includes) and each message subtree (for the flat
# "api/client/v1/...pb.h"-style includes inside Client/) are added. Client/api
# and Client/global_extensions are excluded as include roots: their own files
# include via the "api/..." / "global_extensions/..." prefixes relative to
# Client, so exposing the deeper dirs would create ambiguous header paths.
CollectIncludeDirectories(
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
  PUBLIC_INCLUDES
  # Exclude
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/PrecompiledHeaders
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Client/api
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Client/global_extensions)

target_include_directories(proto
  PUBLIC
    ${PUBLIC_INCLUDES}
  PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})

target_link_libraries(proto
  PRIVATE
    acore-default-interface
    acore-no-warning-interface
  PUBLIC
    common
    protobuf)

if (MSVC)
  # protobuf 2.6.1 generated code uses CRT/STL APIs that newer MSVC flags as
  # deprecated/unsafe; silence them on this generated target only.
  target_compile_definitions(proto
    PRIVATE
      _SCL_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS
      _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)

  target_compile_options(proto
    PRIVATE
      /wd4996)
endif()

set_target_properties(proto
  PROPERTIES
    DEFINE_SYMBOL ACORE_API_EXPORT_PROTO
    FOLDER "server")

if (BUILD_SHARED_LIBS)
  if (UNIX)
    install(TARGETS proto
      LIBRARY
        DESTINATION lib)
  elseif (WIN32)
    install(TARGETS proto
      RUNTIME
        DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
  endif()
endif()

# Generate precompiled header
if (USE_COREPCH)
  add_cxx_pch(proto ${PRIVATE_PCH_HEADER})
endif()
